turns.text: Well, looking back at my mocks, my stories are usually pretty strong, but my answers to why I want to work at this company always end up sounding generic. It just feels cookie-cutter.

turns.text: Well, their platform helps retail inventory managers switch over to new systems, which is the exact pain point I lived through every day. If I say that, it ties my background right into their product.

turns.text: That works because it's specific and personal. Doesn't that feel sturdier than a boilerplate compliment?

turns.text: Definitely. It feels way less fake when I tie it back to my actual store headaches.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Trust that instinct. Do you want to run through that Pellwick answer once out loud, or wrap up and rest?
